pr.title: Count description-check attempts per version, not per PR

summary: A new PR description got no checker if older versions had already used up the 3 tries. Now each version gets its own 3 tries, and a person is asked when they run out.
scenario: The operator wrote three versions of a PR description, and a checker was sent for each one. At 11:00 they write **version 4**. The rule allows **3 checker tries**. Does version 4 get checked?

nodes.title: prDescriptionCheck
nodes.before: counts every try on the PR
nodes.after: counts tries since v4; asks a person at the cap

steps.title: Operator writes version 4 of the PR description.
steps.text: Versions 1 to 3 were each checked once already.

steps.title: The store lists descriptions nobody has checked yet.
steps.before: It returns the text, but not when it was written. Later steps can't tell old tries from new ones.
steps.after: It now also returns `authoredAt`, the time this version was written. Step 4 needs that.

steps.title: Each cycle, the dispatcher gathers its inputs.
steps.text: The unchecked description, plus the last 200 decisions, which include every checker sent before. Not changed by this PR.

steps.title: The rule decides whether to send a checker.
steps.before: It allows 3 tries, but counts **every try on this PR**. The 3 tries on older versions use up the limit.
steps.after: It only counts tries **after v4 was written**, so v4 starts with all 3.

timeline.label: Which checker tries the rule counts

before.label: Counted: every try on this PR

steps.title: What happens to version 4.
steps.before: **Never checked, and nobody is told.** The limit is used up, so nothing is sent.
steps.after: **A checker is sent.** If 3 checkers in a row don't report back, a person is asked instead of it going quiet.
